name: azul_widgets_every_input_form_submits_its_form_data_and_resets
description: The 'Every input type' Form: Submit hands the app the FormData, which the page prints one line per entry (each line's id is form-data-<name>) - the hidden input, the checked checkbox, the radio group, the select with optgroups, a date picker and a text field are all in it. Reset clears the printed data again.

name: azul_widgets_raw_inputs_become_widgets_that_submit
description: The 'Raw HTML inputs' Form: the raw <input>s built with Dom::create_input and the ones parsed from XML are replaced by widgets, and the raw type=submit (replaced by a submit Button that keeps its id) submits the Form around them - the range, the checked checkbox, the checked radio of the group, the select and the XML hidden input are all in the printed FormData (ids raw-form-data-<name>).
